title_tag: Men's Facial in Uluwatu, Bali: Skin Care for Surfers & Travellers
meta: A men's facial in Uluwatu, built for surfers and travellers: deep pore cleanse, sun repair and hydration in under 80 minutes. No fuss, real results.
intro: More and more men book facials in Bali, and many have never had one before. If your skin feels tight after the surf, your nose is full of blackheads, or your forehead is peeling from the sun, a men's facial in Uluwatu is the fastest way to reset. No fragrance overload, no pink robes required.
body_html:
Why men's skin needs a different approach

  • Thicker, oilier skin with larger pores, so congestion builds faster
  • Daily shaving irritates and dehydrates the lower face
  • Hours in the water without re-applying sunscreen
  • Beard area where ingrown hairs and breakouts hide

What happens during a men's facial at Point Face

We don't have a separate "men's menu": we adapt our Korean facials to your skin after a complimentary skin analysis. A typical session looks like this:

  1. Double cleanse to remove salt, sweat and sunscreen
  2. BHA exfoliation for oily zones
  3. Hydrodermabrasion with vortex suction to clear pores
  4. Manual extraction of blackheads on the nose and chin
  5. Cooling or LED therapy to calm razor and sun irritation
  6. Lightweight moisturiser + SPF, no greasy finish

Our most-booked facials for men

  • K-Balance Acne Clear Hydrafacial (70 min) — for oily skin, blackheads and breakouts
  • Ultimate Korean Glass Skin & Hydralift (80 min) — the full reset after weeks of sun and travel
  • Buccal or Kobido massage — de-puffs and defines the jawline, popular before events
  • Back facial (Bingin only) — for surfers with breakouts on the back and shoulders

When to book

After your morning surf is ideal: your pores are open and your skin is ready for hydration. Avoid the sun for the rest of the day, and don't shave for 24 hours after an exfoliating facial.

Simple routine for men in Bali

  • Morning: gel cleanser, light moisturiser, SPF 50
  • After surfing: rinse with fresh water, centella or aloe gel
  • Evening: cleanse, then a hydrating essence
  • Once a month: a professional facial

faq: Do men get facials in Bali?
Yes. Surfers, digital nomads and grooms are among our regular guests.
Will my skin be red afterwards?
Slight pinkness can last an hour after extractions. Most men go straight back to their day.
Should I shave before a facial?
Shave the day before, not the same morning, to avoid irritation.
Can I book with my partner?
Yes, book two treatments at the same time in our Ungasan or Bingin studio.
